# Frogs and toads: Soar agent from the Rosie teaching script

**Runnable.** `frogs-and-toads.soar` loads the shared library (`Soar/soar-library`, v2.42) and `frogs-and-toads-rules.soar` (14 task rules, generated by `gen.py` from the statements in `english-input.txt`; `tools/rosie_swap.py`). Generated 18 Nov 2026. Needs Soar 9.6.6 (or the PyPI soar-sml bindings).

## Run

    python3 ../../tools/run_agent.py . frogs-and-toads.soar --seed 1 --cap 60000
    python3 ../../tools/run_agent.py . frogs-and-toads.soar --json | python3 ../../tools/check_moves.py frogs-and-toads init-frog.world

`python3 gen.py WORLD` writes the same rules with another example state as the initial world.

## Results (library v2.42, 18 Nov 2026)

Example states (`gen.py WORLD`, `run_agent.py --check`): init-frog: goal false, failure false; final-frog: goal true, failure false; second-frog: goal false, failure false.

Seeds 1-3, cap 60,000 decisions; plans replayed independently by `check_moves.py` (legality from the action statements, the losing conditions, the goal).

| Seed | Outcome | Decisions | Actions | Replay |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | success | 736 | 8 | goal holds |
| 2 | success | 710 | 8 | goal holds |
| 3 | success | 849 | 8 | goal holds |

## Translation

- Operator move (argument1 = the block, argument2 = the clear location it moves onto); four proposals, one per move
  statement (4, 7, 10, 11). A toad is a blue block, a frog a red block (statements 6, 8), expanded in place.
- clear is a maintained one-argument relation (statement 5). left-of and right-of are static relations between
  locations; a block is to the left/right of a location when the location it is on is (A-S1).
- The goal (statement 15) is expanded over the blocks of the world file: each block is on a location of its colour (A-S2).
Propose initialize-frogs-and-toads when its conditions below hold.

The assumption codes (A-S, A-G, A-C, A-P) are explained in `tools/rosie_swap.py` and `../../PILOT.md`.
